prior_verdicts.py DEFECT (new): reports FALSE blocking verdicts, two heads. (1) Single-letter tickers defeat the word-boundary matcher -- ticker L matches \bL\b inside 'P&L' because & is a non-word char. (2) The blocking keyword is scoped to the PASSAGE, not the ticker, so any name in a sentence vetoing some OTHER name inherits a false block: DBX was flagged off a passage that explicitly CLEARS DBX while vetoing AVB/BAH. This cost S4 five names tonight. Fix: scope the keyword search to the ticker's own clause, and require len(ticker)>=2 for free-text matching.
